text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert (HIGH) — model-family surge for citrine7b detected. p95 latency spike (4.2s), error rate 8%. dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/incidents/2365489012

alice: paging oncall, I'm up. pulling traces + logs now.

raj: seeing a concentrated stream of long-context streaming requests from a small customer cohort. connections staying open ~4-6m.

alice: impact summary: some customers seeing 429/503 + high tail. routing queue depth up, KV cache eviction high.

*dana*: suggestion — sculpt traffic while we triage. temporary throttle + fallback routing.

alice: plan: 1) throttle citrine7b TPM -> 50; 2) enable fallback to saturn-4b for compatible requests; 3) disable streaming on citrine7b to avoid long-lived KV pressure; 4) notify affected customers + create bypass for critical enterprise accounts. execute? :+1:

raj: executing throttle now.

raj: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.internal/v1/admin/rate-adjust" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"citrine7b","tpm":50,"rpm":1200,"reason":"live surge mitigation"}'
```

opsbot: rate-adjust accepted (change_id=chg-abc123). rollout scheduled to regions within 15s.

alice: opsbot confirms change applied across eu/us. can we also flip streaming=false for citrine7b? dana please?

*dana*: pushing streaming flag off and adding route rule to prefer saturn-4b when client_tag==legacy_streams. snippet: `route add --src model:citrine7b --match client_tag:legacy_streams --dst model:saturn-4b --ttl 1800`

raj: route pushed. measured immediate reduction in active connections to citrine7b (~65% drop) within 60s.

alice: quick metrics update: error rate 8% -> 1.6%, p95 4.2s -> 1.1s. latency tail improving. nice work.

dana: note on customer impact: AcmeCorp experienced intermittent failures at 11:12 UTC. created bypass ticket to allow their traffic to ignore the sculpt for the next 2 hours while SEs migrate.

alice: ticket IN-5987 created and DM'ed to @jordan (Acme SE). Jordan acknowledged.

raj: caution — disabling streaming will break some SDK streaming clients; we've added a graceful server-side message to close streams with error code 1001 + hint to upgrade.

opsbot: autopilot: scheduled auto-escalation in 30m if citrine7b errors > 3% (monitoring job id mon-778).

mikko: I'll take handoff at 11:40 UTC. what remains?

dana: watch metrics for 20m, coordinate with support/SE for customer comms, decide if we need permanent per-customer carveouts or capacity increase. SRE/ML to investigate KV eviction hot-path (files logged).

raj: filed ENG-3342 for follow-up (kv cache tuning + model runtime investigation).

alice: saving runbook + commands. putting summary into the incident tracker and preparing short customer note.

alice: runbook excerpt attached: ```
mitigation:
 - throttle citrine7b tpm=50 rpm=1200 (change_id=chg-abc123)
 - add route preference citrine7b -> saturn-4b for tag:legacy_streams
 - streaming=false for citrine7b
rollback:
 - restore tpm/rpm from snapshot snap-2026-03-15
 - remove route rule
 - streaming=true
```

opsbot: incident status -> mitigated:monitoring.

alice: final note before handoff — observed backend KV eviction rate down 70%, customer-facing errors down to baseline. will reopen if regression. handing off to @mikko.

mikko: taking over. I'll keep an eye and escalate to infra if error creeps back. thanks team.

incident-bot: thread closed for new responses after 2h of inactivity (auto-archive).
